name: io.github.j4flmao/slim-sheet
title: slim-sheet
description: Spreadsheet MCP for any agent: reads xlsx/xls/ods/csv, SQL, cleaning, formulas, safe edits

environmentVariables.name: SLIM_SHEET_TIER
environmentVariables.description: Tool tier: full (28 tools, default), standard (16) or lite (7, for small local models)

environmentVariables.name: SLIM_SHEET_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may read and write, separated by the OS path separator

environmentVariables.name: SLIM_SHEET_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for encrypted workbooks (needs the crypto extra)
